title: Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) — Required Documents, Attestation and Application Channels
content:
## Documents that make an application complete, by tier

| Tier | Document types required | Patient's signed attestation of household and income |
|---|---|---|
| Riverbend Presumptive Charity Care | presumptive evidence | not required |
| Riverbend Full Charity Care (0-200% FPL) | proof of income; proof of residency | required |
| Riverbend 80% Charity Discount (201-250% FPL) | proof of income; proof of residency; BadgerCare Plus determination notice | required |
| Riverbend 60% Charity Discount (251-300% FPL) | proof of income; proof of residency; BadgerCare Plus determination notice | required |
| Riverbend 40% Charity Discount (301-400% FPL) | proof of income; proof of residency | required |
| Riverbend Medical Hardship Assistance (above 400% FPL) | proof of income; proof of residency; outside medical bills; bank statement | required |

## Channels

On every tier of the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) an application may be filed through the patient portal, by mail, or in person with a financial counselor.

### Points of reading

- The list is the set of document types that makes an application complete for the tier; the attestation column states whether the application must carry the patient's own signed attestation of household and income.
- Proof of income is satisfied by any one document from the accepted proof-of-income list (pay stubs for the last 90 days, a federal tax return, a Social Security award letter, an unemployment benefit statement or a zero-income attestation).
